summary: Every legal input is padded to exactly four digit positions, so runtime scaling cannot expose another asymptotic class.

workload_bound.source_constraint: 1 <= num1, num2, num3 <= 9999 and every input is padded to four digits

replacement_checks.evidence: The accepted implementation executes exactly four iterations with one digit extraction and constant arithmetic per input and position.
Regression exhausts all 1000 digit triples independently at each of four positions and checks full-number boundary and deterministic mixed triples against a padded-string oracle.
